title: How Well Do Vision-Language Scene Graphs Serve as Memory for Embodied Question Answering?
abstract: arXiv:2611.34745v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Embodied QA needs memory, but answer accuracy mixes retained evidence, reading errors and question priors. For a simulated multi-room scene-graph pipeline we define answerability: the fraction of questions a fixed rule-based reader answers correctly from the graph alone. The baseline recovers 24.1% of visible object types and its room labels flicker. Four targeted repairs double recall, raise answerability from 27.2% to 37.4%, and improve retrained QA from 71.4% to 75.9%, yet better object F1 can lower answerability. A question-type prior beats this reader on every predicted graph. In one real-video test, graph memory lowers accuracy. These exploratory findings favour scoring retained evidence alongside accuracy.

translated_title: 视觉-语言场景图作为具身问答记忆的效果如何？
translated_abstract: 具身问答（Embodied QA）需要记忆，但答案的准确性混杂了保留的证据、读取错误和问题先验等多种因素。我们针对一个模拟的多房间场景图流水线定义了“可回答性”这一指标：即一个固定的基于规则的读取器仅凭图结构就能正确回答的问题比例。基线系统仅能恢复24.1%的可见物体类型，且其房间标签会闪烁不定。四项针对性修复使召回率翻倍，将可回答性从27.2%提升至37.4%，并使重新训练后的问答准确率从71.4%提升至75.9%；然而更好的物体F1分数反而可能降低可回答性。在所有预测出的图上，一个问题类型先验都能胜过该读取器。在一项真实视频测试中，图记忆反而降低了准确率。这些探索性发现支持在评估答案准确率的同时对记忆中保留的证据进行评分。
tldr: 该论文提出“可回答性”指标来评估视觉-语言场景图作为具身问答记忆的质量，通过四项针对性修复将可回答性从27.2%提升至37.4%，并揭示了答案准确率无法充分反映记忆中保留证据的质量。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces "answerability" as a metric to evaluate vision-language scene graphs as memory for embodied QA, showing that four targeted repairs raise answerability from 27.2% to 37.4% while revealing that answer accuracy alone fails to capture the quality of retained evidence.
